title: My Math Class
text: Every Tuesday, I have math class at school. Today, we learn to add and subtract numbers. My teacher draws a circle, a square, and a triangle on the board. She also draws a star and a heart. We count the shapes together and try to find the pattern. I use a calculator to check my answer. Three plus two is five, and five minus two is three. I have more stickers than my friend, but he wants less homework. Math is my favorite class of the week!
